raw_answer_text:
A1: The Unicast RIB (unicast routing table).
A2: The packet's source address.
A3: NOT STATED.
A4: The interface on which the packet actually arrived.
A5: The router first looks up the route back toward the packet's source, then compares it to the arrival interface.
A6: It passes when the packet arrived on the "upstream" interface (the interface indicated by the source lookup); the router then accepts and forwards it.
A7: It fails when the packet did not arrive on that upstream interface; the router then drops it as an RPF failure.
A8: NOT STATED.
